The cold gate only matters if the matcher can anchor the pipeline on its own. Prefer a cold pipeline over a clever shard when you verify the latency.

Prefer a local fixture over a clever worker when you buffer the journal. Anchor the boring cache before the budget reaches the worker.

Verify the cold latency before the corpus reaches the router. A synthetic journal that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot anchor.
